coldRescore.summary: Cold baseline judgement of assembled-2961 (round 32, R05 yoke). Every measured criterion was copied from measured.json. 10 measured criteria fail: R01.1, R01.6, R03.1, R04.1, R06.10, R07.6, R08.10, R08.11, R09.9 and R10.2. The weakest area by far is the head fan (R03, R04, R12). Its front and back are covered in knobs, nubs, teeth and crinkles. It reads as a flat tray from behind and above, and its profile cavity has picket teeth. The back of the head is a pasted disc with vertical seams (R01.4 fail). The coat idiom is inconsistent: a knobbed fan, faceted cheek plates and bare smooth body clay. The eye outline is still a thin, uneven lid line rather than the bold outline in r01 (R02.2 fail). The trunk side-profile measures all pass. The visual trunk is partial: an abrupt hip flare and a tube-like chest. R05 is partial: the neck and shoulder widths pass, but a faint upper-back band, shoulder-cap nubs and a notch under the jaw remain. The legs and paws are mostly sound visually, but the posed thigh, shin and foot bands fail. Tails: three, stacked and fused at the root, but the lower tips still point down (I05 open, same as baseline; R10 images unchanged). Invariants I01 to I04 and I06 to I09 hold; I05 is open. Caveat: the packet was read-only, so I could not make 2x crops; counts and seams were judged from the packet's own closeup panels.
